【AI Deep Research】
	+ Automatically gather, cross-reference, and synthesize information from multiple sources.
	+ Perfect for students, researchers, analysts, and professionals who need thorough, reliable answers beyond simple Q&A.

【 AI Scheduled Task】
	+ Schedule AI tasks to run automatically at your preferred time — daily, weekly, or custom intervals.
	+ Ideal for automating repetitive research, morning briefings, news, competitor monitoring, and more.

【AI chatbot support】
	+ Vision (Photo)
	+ Document, Pdf attachment.
	+ Custom instruction (Advanced users)
	+ Custom temperature (Advanced users)

【AI Video generation】
	+ Effortless transform your static image to video
	+ Create a video from text prompt.

【AI agent programming】
	+ Effortless build your own standalone agent. Optimize your workload by forcing the structure response with AI

【AI image generation】
	+ Generating images by prompt text with many different models

【AI Text-To-Speech support】
	+ Generating voices from your text, export to file .wav.

【Affordable AI Access】
We offer significant savings compared to single-model apps, providing access to multiple models in a single app. Instead of overpaying for individual models, you have a chance to access all in one app. Would help savings up to 60%.

【What sets us apart?】
We’re a platform that fine-tunes and optimizes leading open-source AI models, ensuring top performance. Our data centers are strategically distributed across continents, guaranteeing low-latency responses no matter where you are.

In addition, we are  a distributor of re-distributing AI models api from the providers such as: Google Gemini, Stability AI, Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama, and more. Our strong dealer-ships allow us to provide you with the best prices in the market.

ScreenReader (VoiceOver) is compatible with AI Hub. A lot of efforts to make AI accessible widely, without borders.

App comes with 2 Plans:
	•	BASE Plan / Always-Free Tier: Perfect for daily tasks. At least, 3 AI models are accessible. Tight rate-limited request. Especially, no-ads, no account required, no prepaid.
	•	PRO Plan: Unlock unlimited access to all available models. Generous rate-limited or advance AI custom.

We Offers PRO plan with:
	•	Weekly, monthly and annually subscription.
	•	Life-time purchase. Premium credit purchase.

Specially, Annual subscription starts with Free-trial starting at zero buck.
